A resonant drive with Rabi frequency $\Omega$ flips the spin after a $\pi$ pulse:
\begin{equation}
\sin\frac{\Omega t}{2} = 1 \qquad \Omega t = \pi .
\label{eq:pi}
\end{equation}
At half filling the occupations of $\pm\varepsilon$ add up to one,
\begin{equation}
\frac{1}{e^{\beta(\varepsilon-\mu)}+1} + \frac{1}{e^{-\beta(\varepsilon+\mu)}+1} = 1 \quad \text{at} \quad \mu = 0 .
\label{eq:ph}
\end{equation}
